newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK FREEZER PRODUCER KLIMASAN TO FLOAT SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TURK FREEZER PRODUCER KLIMASAN TO FLOAT SHARES.

text.p: Turkey's leading freezer producer Klimasan Klima Sanayi ve Ticaret AS will float shares representing 30 percent of its capital in a two-day public offer beginning on Thursday, the company said in a statement.
The fixed price will be 18,000 lira per 1,000 lira nominal valued share in the offer to be lead-managed by Alfa securities.

Klimasan will waive 75 billion lira of preemptive rights to offer them to the public when raising its capital to 250 billion lira from 76.6 billion by issuing 75 billion lira of rights and 98.4 billion lira of bonuses.
Of the 75 million shares to be floated, 52.5 million will be allocated to investors abroad. The consortium managing the offer includes Demir investment and Eczacibasi securities.

Klimasan said it had a 55 percent share in the domestic freezer market and made exports to 16 countries, including Romania, Bulgaria, Russia, Central Asian republics and countries in the Middle East and north Africa under a licence agreement with Danish Derby A/S.
The company plans to raise its output capacity to 100,000 in 1998 from current 75,000.
A 25 percent stake in Klimasan, largely owned by the Senocak family, was sold to Derby and the Industrialisation Fund for Developing Countries in 1993.
The company reported net profits of 65.7 billion lira in the whole of 1996 and 49.5 billion lira in the first quarter of 1997 and net sales of 955.1 billion and 570.3 billion lira, respectively.
